steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.setQuality('high'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; __rhf.god(true); g.env.timeScale=0; g.wildlife.threatPos=()=>({x:1e7,z:1e7,loud:0}); window.__frames=async(n)=>{ for(let i=0;i<n;i++) await new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>r())); }; window.__weather=(cloud,rain,wet)=>{const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=cloud; we.cloudTarget=cloud; we.rain=rain; we.rainTarget=rain; we.wet=wet; we.timer=9999;}; window.__view=async(id,yaw,time,pitch,hud)=>{ const p=g.world.place(id); g.env.setTime(time); g.player.place(p.x,p.z,yaw); g.player.pitch=pitch; g.player.tool='none'; g.viewmodel.setTool('none'); g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); g.hud.show(!!hud); await __frames(4); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); g.env.setTime(time); await __frames(8); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000)); return id+' '+time+' h, wet '+g.fx.uFxWet.value.toFixed(2)+', mist '+g.fx.uFxMist.value.x.toFixed(5)+', rainbow '+g.env.uniforms.uRainbow.value.toFixed(2); }; return 'ok'})()
